description: Generative sequencer that scatters a cloud of points from a seed, joins the ones a set distance apart, and walks that network on each clock to make pitch, gates, accents and two modulation voltages

params.text: Sets the number the cloud of points is generated from, 0 to 999; the same number rebuilds the same cloud
Sets how many points the cloud holds, 8 to 64
Sets the distance at which two points count as joined, 0.25 to 2
Widens or narrows the margin around that distance, 0.01 to 0.2, as the fine adjustment to the radius
Thins or fills the connections in the network, 0% to 100%
Picks how the walker moves: to the next neighbour, to a neighbour chosen by a repeatable pseudo-random rule, or to whichever neighbour has the most connections of its own
Sets how many octaves the pitch output spreads the points across, 1 to 4
Sets the gate length, 5% to 95% of the clock period
Sets how often a step produces a gate at all, 15% to 100%, with the walker moving on either way
Freezes the phrase into a repeating loop: to the right a 16-step loop and to the left a 32-step loop, further from the centre freezing more of the steps

inputs.text: The clock the walker moves on; each rising edge takes it to another point, and with this jack empty nothing advances
A rising edge returns the walk to its starting state, so a phrase can repeat from the same place
Adds to the seed knob, a hundred seeds per volt, which rebuilds the whole cloud; slow or stepped voltages suit it, audio rate does not
Adds to the density knob, a tenth of its travel per volt

outputs.text: The pitch of the current point, taken from its horizontal position and quantised to C minor
A 10V gate when the current point produces one, its length set by the gate length knob
An accent voltage from 0 to 10V, higher for a point with more connections of its own
A 0 to 10V reading of the current point's horizontal position, the same figure the pitch is made from
A 0 to 10V reading of the current point's vertical position, as a second modulation source

notes: the display draws the network as it stands: points, the lines joining them, and the current point in fuchsia, drawn larger for a longer gate and brighter for a higher gate density.
the module is deterministic: the same seed and the same knob positions rebuild the same network and the same phrase.
menu: Poly seed mode: Shared seed, Per-voice seed — whether the extra polyphonic voices offset one cloud or each build a cloud of their own
Poly voices — how many channels every output carries, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 or 8

inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
